purpose: Teach: 本稿/索引/貯蔵/税源/不服/優待/競売/課金

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本稿の事件報告を共有しております
lines.en: We're sharing our case report with you today.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Slight formality in posture. Clear enunciation on key words. Even pacing, no rush. The tone of someone who has explained this many times and means to be understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、事件索引を新しく整備されたんですね
lines.en: Yes — and I see the police have reorganised the case index recently.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Slight nod in the voice. Acknowledging what's been done. Warm but formal enough to match the occasion. A pause before the second clause, as if absorbing the information.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収物を安全な貯蔵庫に保管しております
lines.en: We're keeping all seized materials stored safely in our secure facility.
lines.style: Factual, steady. No inflection seeking approval. Businesslike rhythm. The confidence of someone explaining standard procedure. Slight emphasis on 'secure' — reassurance without overselling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、税源確保にも貢献されているそうですね
lines.en: Yes — and we've confirmed that the police are also supporting revenue collection efforts.
lines.style: Engaged, affirmative. A slight smile in the voice. Acknowledging something positive. Measured pace, professional but warmer than before. The tone of someone impressed by thoroughness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民の不服申し立てに丁寧に対応しております
lines.en: We respond to all citizen complaints with careful attention.
lines.style: Deliberate, conscientious. Slight weight on 'carefully.' Even breath. The voice of someone who takes responsibility seriously. No defensiveness, just matter-of-fact commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者向け優待制度のご案内ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes — and thank you for sharing information about victim support services.
lines.style: Warm appreciation breaking through formality. Genuine tone, not performative. A slight lean-in in the voice. The relief of someone hearing that support exists. Sincere without being effusive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品競売の手続きを進めております
lines.en: We're moving forward with the procedures for auctioning seized goods.
lines.style: Steady, professional. Neutral on the content — neither emphasizing nor downplaying. Clear enunciation. The bureaucratic rhythm of someone reporting progress without editorial comment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違反者への課金状況を確認させていただきました
lines.en: Yes — I've confirmed the billing status on violations.
lines.style: Businesslike, conclusive. Slight finality in the tone. Efficient, crisp delivery. The voice of someone closing a loop, satisfied with what's been verified. Professional but less formal than earlier lines — the ease of finishing.
